note: Declared BEFORE any deviation number was computed. No scan-side mask: the gated scan->CAD statistic is therefore the unmasked one. The two CAD-side masks are the standard B02 protocol masks; they affect only the reported CAD->scan masked statistic (the gated CAD->scan statistic is the observable-only split, which does not use masks).

masks.name: M3 open boundary
masks.why: distance from CAD to the edge of a scan hole (23 open loops, INTAKE_CARD §2-§3) is not a surface deviation

masks.name: M4 skin normal
masks.why: a CAD point whose nearest scan triangle faces >70 deg away is an occluded/opposite-wall correspondence, not a skin deviation
